patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often contained within a central maximum width, creating a clean, structured feel, while some elements like the hero video are full-bleed.
Horizontal scrolling carousels are used for 'Publications' and 'Featured investments' sections, allowing for a large number of items without excessive vertical space.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established using a large, elegant serif font for the primary hero heading and a clean, modern sans-serif for all other headings, body text, and navigation.
A consistent brand palette of dark teal/green, light grey, and white is used for backgrounds, text, and interactive elements, creating a professional and cohesive look.
The main navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid white background with a subtle shadow as it becomes sticky after scrolling past the hero section.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that subtly animates or parallaxes as the user scrolls, adding dynamic visual interest.
Content sections below the hero appear to reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Informative cards with illustrative line-art icons are used to represent 'Our investment themes,' providing a visually engaging overview of key areas.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is sticky, initially transparent over the hero, and gains a solid white background and subtle shadow after scrolling. The hero section uses a full-bleed video background that subtly parallaxes or animates with scroll depth. Content sections below the hero are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely using a scroll-triggering library. Horizontal content sections utilize a carousel component (like Swiper) for navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: A very large, elegant serif for the hero heading (~4-5x body text) contrasts with clear, well-spaced sans-serif headings (~1.5-2.5x body text) and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) are applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card elements, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in the hero section and between major content blocks, with a slightly denser but still readable layout within card grids.

standout: The site effectively blends a sophisticated, elegant serif typeface for its primary hero statement with a clean, modern sans-serif for the rest of the content, creating a distinctive and authoritative yet approachable feel. The use of subtle line-art illustrations within themed cards and a dynamic video hero further elevates its visual appeal beyond typical corporate templates.
